title: AnyEarn
tagline: A Peer-to-peer Services WebApp fully on chain!!!.Presenting to You, Your Side-Gig Champ!!.
description: AnyEarn is a web3 Services platform that aims to provide an extra source of income.AnyEarn is a place where users can put in services that could almost be anything.The whole verification process is done by Self Protocol,which makes our webApp much more safer and easier for people to trust.Who knows you might even make it more secure than it can already get
how_its_made: The technology i have used is Scaffold-Eth 2.0 ,hardhat config,NextJS,TailwindCSS along with TypeScript as well.Using AI,i have learned and deployed my web3 hackathon.Using Scaffold-Eth saved me a lot of time to not study all the unwanted things and thus increased my activeness in the class.The Language used for blockchain implementation was solidity.
